clue.text: In favour of action, daughter is moving ahead

parts.note: to be for something is to be in favour of it
military action is war

explanation.surface: A supporter of action whose daughter is making progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: something going onward or advancing is heading to the front.

clue.text: Firm reduced by half since company's disaster

indicators.note: only the first two of the four letters are kept, the word halved

parts.note: as can mean since, as in as it rained

explanation.surface: A business halved in size: the company is in ruins.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a humiliating failure or debacle.

clue.text: Feel bitter now having lost opener

indicators.note: the opener is the first letter, which is dropped

parts.note: the present is now, the current time

explanation.surface: A batting side is sour now its opening batsman is out.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to begrudge or take offence at something.

clue.text: Go up for prize

definitions.meaning: to rise in value, as property does
to prize is to value highly

explanation.surface: Rising up to collect an award.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prize' looks like a noun, an award, but is the verb: to treasure.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to increase in worth over time, and to value or be grateful for.

clue.text: Research done, primarily, on most of magical beings

indicators.note: primarily means firstly, so only the opening letter is used
most of means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: elves are magical beings of folklore

explanation.surface: A study of fairy folk has been mostly completed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to dig deep or investigate thoroughly.

clue.text: In block of flats, an actor returned for a card game

indicators.note: returned means the hidden run is read backwards, right to left
the letters sit inside, as a block within, the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: An actor living in a flat comes back home to play cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In block of' marks a hidden run across 'flats, an actor'; 'returned' says read it backwards: (fl)ATS AN AC(tor) reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rummy-style game played with two packs, popular in mid-century America.

clue.text: Disease in grouse

definitions.meaning: a grouse is a grumble or grievance

explanation.surface: An illness found in a game bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grouse' looks like the game bird but is a grumble.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: an ailment, and an expression of dissatisfaction.

clue.text: Socially unacceptable foreign noun

indicators.note: foreign means strange or alien, so the letters are made unfamiliar by rearrangement

explanation.surface: A noun from another language is not used in polite society.
explanation.walkthrough: U and NON-U are British labels for upper-class and not upper-class speech or behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: a British term for language or behaviour judged not upper-class.

clue.text: Scornful of son having organised raid on clubs

indicators.note: organised means put in order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at a son who planned a nightclub raid.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: mocking or cynically derisive.

clue.text: A page on pop, perhaps, is easy to understand

parts.note: pop is a father, an example of a parent, hence perhaps

explanation.surface: A page of pop music is simple to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pop' looks like music but is dad.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: clear or evident, plain to see.

clue.text: Sit with a revolutionary storyteller

indicators.note: something revolutionary turns round, so the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: Someone sitting down with a political radical who tells tales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like a description of a person but turns POSE + A around.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the ancient Greek author of fables such as the tortoise and the hare.

clue.text: Sweet fruit dip

parts.note: a lemon is a citrus fruit
a dip or fall is a drop

explanation.surface: A sugary dip for fruit, like a dessert fondue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' looks like an adjective for the fruit but is the noun: a confection.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a boiled confection flavoured with citrus, a type of candy.

clue.text: Rags-to-riches story recalled in novel

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters take a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A tale of poverty to wealth is remembered within a book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like the book but is the anagram signal on 'recalled in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the fairy tale of the cinder-girl who marries the prince is the classic poverty-to-fortune plot.

clue.text: Fell in dock

definitions.meaning: a fell is an upland stretch of open wild ground, a heath
to dock a boat is to tie it up at a berth

explanation.surface: Someone tumbled into the harbour, or into the courtroom dock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fell' reads as a verb but is the noun for open hill country, used in northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: open upland heath, and to secure a vessel with ropes or anchor.

clue.text: Fix a drink entertaining a duke — cocktail required

parts.note: to pin is to fix in place

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so the drink holds the other letters inside

parts.note: cola is a soft drink

explanation.surface: A host mixes a drink for a visiting duke and needs a cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a rum, coconut and pineapple mixed drink.

clue.text: Analytical essay — it is on squid, I suspect

indicators.note: something suspect is dubious or not straight, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A writer suspects a learned paper has been written about squid.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a long formal discourse or treatise examining a subject in depth.

clue.text: Bad in first half of reel after square dance

indicators.note: after means this part follows the square

parts.note: a quad is a quadrangle, a square courtyard

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece
only the first two of the four letters are kept

parts.note: ill means bad, as in ill effects

explanation.surface: A clumsy reel follows a square dance at a ceilidh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square dance' reads as one phrase, but 'square' is wordplay and 'dance' alone defines; 'after' places the reel part second.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a French square dance for four couples.

clue.text: Check on board earlier vessel

indicators.note: on board means carried inside, so these letters go within the other piece

parts.note: sooner means earlier
CH is the chess abbreviation for check

explanation.surface: An inspection was made aboard the ship earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sailing ship with fore-and-aft rigging on two or more masts.

clue.text: Completely unacceptable claim

parts.note: out means not allowed, as in that is out
a right is an entitlement or claim

explanation.surface: A wholly outrageous demand.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: totally, without reservation.

clue.text: Reportedly picked up crowd controller for trial

indicators.note: reportedly means as heard, so the words are spoken and the sound is spelt differently

parts.note: picked up means caught, and a marshal controls crowds at events

explanation.surface: A steward who was arrested now faces a hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a hearing held by a military tribunal to try service personnel.

clue.text: Surface cut short ahead

parts.note: to crop is to cut short, as with hair
up means ahead, as in two goals up

explanation.surface: A surface trimmed down at the front.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Surface' is the verb: to appear or arise.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to emerge or come up unexpectedly.

clue.text: Immediately make amends round about

indicators.note: round means the first piece goes around the other

parts.note: to atone is to make amends
C stands for circa, Latin for about

explanation.surface: Apologise quickly and make up all round.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: straight away, without delay.

clue.text: Turn back on monster

indicators.note: back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a turn in a game is a go
re means on or concerning, as in business letters

explanation.surface: Someone turns around to face a beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turn back' looks like one phrase but 'Turn' is the word and 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a man-eating giant of fairy tales.

clue.text: Noble actor is portrayed differently in painting

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: painting is a form of art

indicators.note: portrayed differently means the letters are presented in another arrangement

explanation.surface: An actor plays a nobleman in a different way on canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a peer or member of the titled upper class.

clue.text: Fur, first of bargains in market

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: a sale is a market event where goods are sold

indicators.note: first of means only the opening letter is used

explanation.surface: A fur coat is the best of the bargains at a market.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the dark fur of a small Asian marten.

clue.text: Heads turned in shock

indicators.note: turned means turned around, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: nut is slang for a head

explanation.surface: People turn their heads in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to daze or astound.

clue.text: Bad thing, stick in cabaret

indicators.note: bad means wrong or spoiled, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: a club is a heavy stick

explanation.surface: A nasty object, a stick, wedged inside a cabaret show.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a late-night venue with music and entertainment.

clue.text: Type of poplar tree in a small enclosure

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small in clothing sizes
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A poplar is growing in a little fenced plot.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the trembling poplar, known for its quaking leaves.

clue.text: Followers reunite in resort

indicators.note: to re-sort is to sort again, so the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A group of fans gather again at a holiday resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' looks like a holiday spot but is read as re-sort, the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the entourage of attendants accompanying an important person.

clue.text: Former partner, big enough for a model

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
ample means sufficient or plenty

explanation.surface: An ex-partner who is a full-figured fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' looks like a fashion model but means a pattern to copy.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a specimen or pattern to be copied or followed.
